# v0.1.0 workspace fixture

`agent-workspace.json` was generated by booting the real JSON storage stack from release source commit `a659ee3827a4cd77188e24ad3a7d1ed20145813b`, executing the persistence scenario from that commit's `tests/restart.integration.spec.ts`, and disposing the stack so the backend flushed its durable file. Tests copy this file into a temporary storage root before boot and never open the fixture itself for writing.
